digest.component_or_area: pytest temporary directory management and nested subprocess isolation
propositions: Nested pytest child processes launched without explicit --basetemp allocate pytest's user-global numbered temp root, causing cleanup_numbered_dir to delete unrelated cleanup-eligible trees at session finish.

test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active and test_repro_module_passes_standalone execute nested pytest children under repository autouse fixtures without providing parent-owned basetemp, allowing those children to join and corrupt the shared numbered root.

Parent pytest processes must pass a unique --basetemp derived from their own tmp_path to each executing nested child to ensure cleanup scope isolation and prevent deletion of unrelated temporary directories.

Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup for the numbered root; only child processes that allocate _basetemp via fixture resolution can reach this cleanup code at pytest_sessionfinish.
